core.title: The documentation-graph resolver lives in the owning extension
core.when: You plan where the resolver code lives.
core.then: The resolver MUST live in the extension that owns the documentation graph.
avoid: Placing the resolver in a shared utility module outside the owning extension.
core.why: Spec 2 §5.4 places the resolver in the owning extension.
evidence: The resolver's code is located inside the owning extension's module.
verification: Strict disposition at severity 1: every finding fails the run; there is no advisory mode and no ratchet baseline.

A validator checks that the resolver's code is located inside the owning extension's module (the placement required by spec 2 §5.4), matching the resolver's code paths against the owning extension's location from the profile; the validator and finding ids of this rule are realization details.

Observing the change facts (resolver source changed / resolver moved) needs a new observer whose path mapping is the owning extension's location from the profile: a change to the resolver source inside that location raises docs_resolver_source_changed, and a move of the resolver out of it raises docs_resolver_moved.

fires: A plan puts the resolver in a shared utility module outside the owning extension.
doesNotFire: Pure markup authoring with no resolver work.

profileRequirements.meaning: Location (path segment or glob) of the extension that owns the documentation graph, so that 'the resolver lives in the owning extension' is checkable against concrete paths (inside the location) and so the change observer can map resolver source changes and moves to this location.
The markup file suffixes of the documentation corpus, so that 'pure markup authoring' names the realization's authored documents.

bunOnly.reason: It names the realization's concrete shared-utility package; the neutral core keeps only stack-neutral task terms and the Bun realization restores this one for plan-text matching.
The validator id and shared-policy reference id of this one rule are realization details; the core's verification describes the check generically.

classification.note: 'The docs-graph resolver' is restated as the documentation-graph resolver; no stack content.
One obligation: placement in the owning extension; which extension owns the graph and where it lives is profile data (layout.locations#extension_dir = src/atdd/docs/** in the Bun realization).
The spec 2 §5.4 citation is convention-level, not stack-level, so it is kept.
'A shared package outside the docs extension' becomes a shared utility module outside the owning extension; the concrete boundary is the profile's extension location.
Observable restatement: resolver code inside the owning extension's location (the profile's glob for the extension).
The check is described generically in core.verification: resolver code paths must match the extension location from the profile; the concrete location is profile data.
Three task terms are neutral and stay in the core; 'coach utils' names the realization's shared-utility package and is bunOnly.
Change values are neutral event names; the fact's note ('needs a path mapping for the docs extension') is satisfied by the profile key, whose concrete value (src/atdd/docs/**) supplies that mapping.
'Shared utility package outside the docs extension' neutralized to shared utility module outside the owning extension; the concrete outside/inside boundary is the profile's extension location.
'.adoc' is the realization's markup suffix; the core says 'pure markup authoring' and takes the suffix from the profile.
Severity 1 and strict disposition go to core:verification; the validator ref and shared-policy id are bunOnly.

neutralityNotes: The obligation itself is placement/ownership, so it neutralizes cleanly: the resolver lives in the extension that owns the graph, never in a shared utility module. Two things could not be neutral: (1) which extension owns the graph and where it lives — supplied as an entry of the v3 map key layout.locations (layout.locations#extension_dir, Bun value src/atdd/docs/**, the docs capability that is a sibling of the shared-utility tree named in the source), referenced by then/avoid/evidence/verification and the change observer; (2) the task term 'coach utils' and the validator ref 'docs_capability' name realization specifics and stay bunOnly. 'Spec 2 §5.4' is a convention-level citation, not a stack artifact, and is kept verbatim. The '.adoc' suffix in doesNotFire is reconstructed from suffix.markup. The 'additions' block of bun.json is rewrite provenance, not an obligation, so it is not classified.
